items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Ben Bard, who married Ruth Holland

ctx.x: When Gus Wick opened up, we had a makeup box.
Ben Bard, who married Ruth Holland, and, uh, Martha Pryor, beautiful boxing girl, saying, I ain't got no body, don't shake my tree. Pieces, something like that.
